CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #19
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

   D. Say Responsibility over Plants has no place in daily life.

   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing The Birth and Childhood of Jesus Christ.

7. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately

8. Which response best shows understanding of Accounts of Creation? (1 mark)

11. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust

   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Skipping all moral lessons
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

15. Which response best shows understanding of Bible Translation? (1 mark)
